entry.title: SurgeXXL 0.2.0
entry.summary: **SurgeXXL 0.2.0** — Surge XT 1.3.4's synth engine as a native MPC OS instrument for the Force (MPC OS 3.x). > **This is the fix for "SurgeXXL loads nothing / crashes MPC".** Every earlier version (0.1.0-0.1.3) failed at the very first step on a Force: MPC runs plugins with no `HOME` variable, Surge asked for it while starting, and no instance could be made (the crash log said `create: exception The environment variable HOME is unset or empty`). Fixed, and every offline test now runs without HOM
